input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-and-exclusive-provider commitment in Section 2.2, as we do not accept exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations and must remain free to engage other suppliers. It also contradicts Sections 2.1 and 12.3 (no purchase commitment and no exclusivity); if some exclusivity is commercially important, we could discuss a narrow 12-month category-specific arrangement that ends automatically on any service level or delivery failure.
input.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity obligation binding Customer.
